description.value: Hooked Fish Bar is a fully licensed beachfront restaurant that has been a Crescent Beach landmark since opening in summer 2011, offering a wrap-around deck with unobstructed views of the ocean and Gulf Islands. The menu is built around seafood classics — fish & chips, fish tacos, and chowder — alongside a dry-aged sirloin burger and a well-curated local and international beer selection. A dedicated takeout window serves the boardwalk crowd, and the casual, lively dining room screens sporting events on large televisions.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Hooked Fish Bar is a real, year-round beachfront restaurant at 12157 Beecher Street, Crescent Beach (a neighbourhood of Surrey), BC, with phone 604.542.4665 matching OSM's +1-604-542-4665. Takeout is explicitly confirmed via 'The take out window has been a hit'; OSM tags internet_access=wlan but the website does not mention Wi-Fi, so it is marked null per rules. No bike parking, washrooms, water refill, or other amenity evidence appears in either the website or OSM tags.
concerns: OSM lists the city as 'Surrey' while the website uses 'Crescent Beach, BC'; Crescent Beach is a neighbourhood within Surrey, so this is a naming convention difference rather than a true discrepancy.
Website copyright footer reads 2013, suggesting the site may not be actively maintained, though the business shows no signs of closure.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open, year-round beachfront restaurant with a takeout window — useful stop for touring cyclists on the Crescent Beach boardwalk area.
